title: Great getaway for 2!!
text: Great way to see both sides of the river and enjoy champagne and chocolates. Perfect end to our week in Sevilla. Weather was great and Jose took good care of us!
author: Kim_O

title: Relaxation
text: Great, good guide. Nice view of Seville. From the water a good view of the old town and the sights in the city.
